usefulness.rationale: The dossier itself contains only two narrow, well-cited claims from a single 2015 archive.org video: that Bazin was PDG of Accor at the 28 April 2015 general assembly, and that a shareholder asked him about US-minimum-wage-level compensation. Both are directly supported by the quoted passage. No dossier statement overreaches its citation, so no overclaims are found; the three listed unjustified conclusions (PSG sale, HeForShe pay parity, Accor ownership) do not appear as dossier claims and thus cannot be matched. Understanding is low: a reader learns only his 2015 role and one anecdote, not his Colony Capital history, PSG presidency, or current status (the 2015 role is historical, though the dossier correctly dates it rather than asserting it as current). RemainingQuestions is low because the dossier never states what it does not know — it implies coverage of his career from two sentences. ConversationReadiness is minimal: one dated anecdote and a role confirmation give little to prepare a meeting with.
